race.title: Cavan Developments Supporting St Marys GAA Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: THE MOURNE RAMBLER was among last season’s leading bumper performers and looks to have been found an ideal starting point over hurdles, with Whisky Lads feared most after showing marked improvement when third at Punchestown last time and bumper winners Low Kick and Caman Hill also respected. THE MOURNE RAMBLER (IRE) WHISKY LADS (IRE) LOW KICK (FR)
race.bettingForecast: The Mourne Rambler (8/11), Low Kick (3/1), Caman Hill (9/2), Whisky Lads (10/1), Ignite The Moment (14/1), Finest Band (20/1), Fortunate Miss (33/1), Rough And Tough (50/1), Marian Place (66/1), Ataboymiley (100/1), An Ceanabhan Ban (100/1), Eagle Doll (100/1)
